text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Taiki. Perfect timing—I was just looking for someone to partner with.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That sounds wicked to the max! And how about we go grab some eats at a fusion restaurant when we're done?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey now, baby! What's with that funky look? C'mon, let's book it to the track already!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You don't seem like your usual self, Taiki… Is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's sharp! Suzuka, you're so perceptive! You've totally caught on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've actually been conducting some secret lessons with Taiki recently, and now she's super fly! Her speed's totally tubular compared to before!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh… Well, speed aside, it looks like you've rubbed off on her in some other ways as well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it does sound like she's picked up some hip lingo during our lessons. Anyhoo, that darlin's vocab is in apple-pie order now, bub.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wait… Did she rub off on you too, Maruzen?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My speed and style are both radically bodacious right now! C'mon, Suzuka—let's hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Course, thanks to those lessons, my own racin' is fine as gravy too! Boy howdy, is that a three-way duel I smell?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Let's just start running already. I feel like my head's spinning here…
